title: Deeper/broader ACIS writer branch, carrier closure, and comparator freshness review
mode: primary-source web research with local implementation-plan crosswalk
scope: Refresh the status and merge-base ambiguity of ACadSharp ACIS writer/schema PRs
Cross-check open-source reports about modern AcDs/SAB loss and DXF NOD selection
Reassess the exact limits of ezdxf and FreeCAD as carrier and consumer comparators
Refine existing implementation gates without adding a new finding or validation burden

method.kind: Review public primary repository, issue, pull-request, and project documentation pages; reconcile findings with the existing plan
method.limitations: Peer claims were not reproduced. ACadSharp #1150's report about repeated group-310 reads is not attributed to merged master because linked PR #1174 remains open on its page; exact source revisions and merge-base must be pinned before any future execution. LibreDWG #1411/#1413 are issue-author reports. FreeCAD source/docs review is not an application qualification. No DWG/DXF samples or attachments were downloaded.

sources.revision: Live PR page reviewed 2026-10-18; five commits, latest visible force-push 098d7a3; PR open
sources.observed: Contributor describes SAT/DXF and SAT/SAB DWG writer paths, reports manual opens across R2000/R2004/R2007/R2010/R2013 except R2007 DWG writer unavailability, and records TrueView-driven SAT group-boundary and subclass fixes. Oct. 1 discussion says the branch conflicts with the refactored reader and reports that the DXF ACDSDATA reader retained only the last repeated group-310 chunk; maintainer prefers a schema-driven writer rather than raw section replay.
sources.limits: Unmerged branch; no peer build/test/review was performed here. The group-310 observation is contributor-reported and must not be called current-master behavior without pinning and checking the exact merged source revision.

sources.revision: Live PR page reviewed 2026-10-18; PR marked open
sources.observed: The proposal introduces structured ACDS storage/schema and updates DXF/DWG reader infrastructure; its page still shows open status.
sources.limits: The status conflicts with wording in #1150 that says '#1174 is in'. No inference about whether the code is in a different master commit is safe without exact base/master SHA and merge-base inspection.

sources.revision: Live PR page reviewed 2026-10-18; PR marked open and depends on #1174
sources.observed: Proposes DXF writer support for ACIS-dependent Region, CadBody, and Solid3D entities.
sources.limits: Unmerged implementation proposal, not released writer capability or independent acceptance evidence.

sources.revision: Open issue reviewed 2026-10-18; reported peer build 0.14.8593 at 8a1ae764
sources.observed: Issue author gives a scratch-generation recipe for an AC1032 DXF REGION with a 5,489-byte SAB body and reports loss of SAB/AcDs through that LibreDWG build. A separate confidential R2018 drawing is mentioned.
sources.limits: Not independently reproduced; build- and route-scoped negative report, not evidence about current master or libdxfrw. Confidential sample is unavailable and was not downloaded.

sources.observed: Reporter says the writer chooses a first/lowest-handled DICTIONARY instead of the NOD and reports patched-vs-unpatched differences in two of 43 production files.
sources.limits: Issue-author diagnosis/counts only; production samples unavailable, no independent reproduction, and not a normative specification.

sources.observed: Documents SAT/SAB helpers and scratch body generation; mesh extraction handles flat polygonal faces only, with curved/spline surfaces requiring an ACIS kernel.
sources.limits: Useful for deterministic carrier controls and bounded parsing, not a general ACIS/B-rep semantic oracle.

sources.project: FreeCAD DWG importer source and DXF import documentation
sources.revision: Mutable main source and published DXF contract reviewed 2026-10-18
sources.observed: DWG import is converter-mediated and feeds a DXF importer; published documentation states stock DXF import does not consume embedded ACIS solids.
sources.limits: Source and documentation review only; no native FreeCAD app, platform package, converter, or plugin was run. Qualify the exact app/build/platform path before any consumer claim.

sources.observed: Existing plan already contains multi-chunk carrier, NOD identity/owner, exact consumer-route, scratch-fixture, and validation-cadence gates; the update makes the peer revision pinning and layer-by-layer pass criteria explicit.
sources.limits: Local plan is an implementation artifact, not external evidence.

assessment.planImpact: At already-planned composed checkpoints, pin peer head/base/master SHA and merge-base before interpreting branch reports; test every repeated group-310 chunk, length/hash, owner/key association, reachability, and following-record sentinel separately; treat LibreDWG #1411 as an exact-build negative control; preserve NOD-by-identity/owner; use ezdxf for scratch carrier controls rather than curved B-rep semantics; keep FreeCAD on its exact converter-to-DXF consumer path.
